entities.summary: Francisco Morato is a suburban city in the state of São Paulo in Brazil. It is part of the Metropolitan Region of São Paulo. The population is 177,633 in an area of 49.00 km2 (18.92 sq mi). The suburban city is served by the CPTM Line 7.
